page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal reference numbers (224–229) stand in the right margin beside the lines; running head at the top; signature at the foot.

p.i: in Ecclesia amplius perdurare, soluebat illam pu-tredinem in nido isto diabolico congregatam: et diuisit in duo capita, ut melius pateat sanies & uirulentia antichristi.

main_text.p: Hostia consecrata est naturaliter uerus pa-nis, & sacramentaliter corpus Christi.224
Cum uia ponens panem manere, sit plus con-fona scripturæ, rationi & sensui, quam uia fin-gens accidens manere sine subiecto: Deus uerax non est autor huius noui operis somniati.225
Quod papa sit summus pontifex, est ridicu-lum, & Christus nec in Petro, nec in alio talem approbat dignitatem.226

Ex fide & operibus quatuor sectarum qui sunt clerus cæsarius, uarius monachus, uarius ca-nonicus atq; fratres, euidenter elicio quod nulla persona istarum est membrum Christi in sancto-rum catalogo, nisi in fine dierū deseruerint tam stolidam suam sectam.227
Augustinus et Hieronymus cū cæteris deserue-runt sectas istas, & sic religiosi nostri possent re-ligionem suā mendosam deserere, & Christi reli-gione, relicta sua apostasia, sapienter accipere.228
A probabili creditur q; uacata beneficia ab episcopis uocatis et rectoribus forēt omnino su-spensa, et gratis euangelizantes haberet strictæ ui229

page.notes: The bottom line "Cc iiij" is the gathering signature. Some words in the last lines are damaged by show-through and the scan edge; the final word of the page is printed as "ui" with the line continuing beyond the visible print.
